★ THE GREAT AMERICAN CROSSING · COAST TO COAST BY RAIL

The Great American Crossing

Chicago to San Francisco on the storied Zephyr route — the plains, the Rockies' canyons, the desert and the Sierra, from the dome car and the dining car. Tap a leg to ride it.

Modelled on the real California Zephyr route — real stations, canyons and passes shown accurately with facts from public sources. The operator and package are a generic composite (SO-1b) — a demo a real rail-tour operator could publish. Prices indicative (±) — booking, availability and seats are the agency's craft — photography: AI-generated, illustrative.
